services.name: Fishing Charters
services.desc: Capt. Brian Sawyer invites you to come fish the Nature Coast on fly or light tackle for an epic journey in the skinny waters located here in Homosassa, Florida. Homosassa is home to sight fishing for redfish, snook, sea trout, flounder, black drum, and many other popular gamefish that make Florida the “Fishing Capital of the World”. In addition we offer seasonal Homosassa Tarpon fishing and Crystal River Tarpon Fishing. We also target Tarpon seasonally, and during that season - as a priority in our service lineup. We specialize in fishing for Tarpon on fly tackle, but we can also cater trips to meet your specific needs. We can also venture into deeper nearshore waters thanks to our Maverick

blurb: Capt. Brian Sawyer guides fishing trips targeting species like Tarpon, Redfish, Snook, and others in the Nature Coast's backcountry waters. He also offers duck hunting charters and turkey hunts. Trips are customized to client goals and current conditions for a rewarding outdoor adventure.

quotes.author: Bob Beckers
quotes.text: . 2022 Capt. Brian provides a great experience, high end rods&reels, and in my case a bucket list fish! The weather tried to chase us off the water, Brian had a back up plan, and put me on a 100# class tarpon! Would highly recommend, will hire again. 2023. Back out with Capt. Brian a year later and had just as much fun. This time Brian got us into big numbers of fish, and once again the weather didn’t help any. But Brian delivered results. I should start letting him book my vacations, I’d probably catch better weather.

quotes.author: Andrew Lenhart-Frey
quotes.text: Just finished up a three day hunt with Brian at Double Bar B Outfitters. It was a great time and their hospitality was amazing. They were extremely professional and knew exactly where we needed to be and when. The lodge was clean and well stocked with food and drinks and meals were from a local catering spot. I would definitely recommend using them and plan to on my next Osceola hunt.

quotes.author: Kyla G
quotes.text: Capt Brian Sawyer is one of the best! He knows what he is doing and I can’t wait for our next duck hunt! You will have a great time and I would recommend him to anyone I know!

quotes.author: blake smith
quotes.text: Brian, Nate, and Parker did an awesome job of getting us on birds. All three of us tagged out before lunch on day one. Beautiful setting and even better hunting.

quotes.author: Sam Haught
quotes.text: Capt Brian is the real deal! Knows his stuff and put us on the ducks. Shot a limit of blues and had a blast doing it. We'll be back
